briefTitle: ORACLE: Observation of ResiduAl Cancer With Liquid Biopsy Evaluation

typedChecks.sourceText: Cohort 2: Cohort 2: Non-small cell lung cancer (stage IB-III):
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Cohort 2: Cohort 2: Non-small cell lung cancer (stage IB-III):

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Initial treatment is given with curative/radical intent AND
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Treatment intent is subjective and not a typed clinical check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Are planning to undergo regular follow-up and monitoring for cancer recurrence per standard of care at the enrolling site AND
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Follow-up planning is subjective and not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Provided written informed consent to participate in the study AND
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Informed consent is a standard administrative requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Are willing to have de-identified clinical data shared with investigators at regular intervals as outlined in the study protocol and informed consent AND
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Data sharing willingness is administrative.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Are willing to provide blood samples at enrollment and at subsequent clinical visits coinciding with standard of care follow-up, for up to 3 years as outlined in the study protocol and informed consent AND
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness to provide blood samples is a procedure requirement.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have at least one Landmark blood sample collected. Landmark samples are collected 3-12 weeks after surgery, chemotherapy and/or radiation/chemoradiation as applicable based on the participant's planned treatment regimen
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Landmark sample timing depends on planned treatment regimens.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of allogeneic organ or tissue transplant
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior transplant history is an exclusion not covered by a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Index cancer has predominantly neuroendocrine histology
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Predominantly neuroendocrine histology is not a standard typed histology exclusion kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: History of another primary cancer diagnosed within 3 years of enrollment, with the exception that in situ cancers, non-melanoma skin carcinomas, localized low- or intermediate risk prostate cancers (defined as cancers confined to the prostate with Gleason score of 7 or lower and prostate-specific antigen (PSA) of less than 20), and stage I papillary thyroid carcinoma, and participants with bilateral/multifocal tumors within the same organ (for example, bilateral breast cancer) are allowed if diagnosed within 3 years of enrollment
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: History of another primary cancer with complex multi-disease exceptions is not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known distant metastasis at time of enrollment (with the exception of participants with limited/resectable stage IV cutaneous melanoma or RCC)
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Distant metastasis exclusion with cohort-specific exceptions is not a typed check.
